topic: Holding investments for long-term capital gains rates vs selling short-term (Otis vs Delphine)

scenes.narration: Selling a winning stock one month too early can double your tax. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room pointing at a stock chart and a calendar, comic burst banner reads CAPITAL GAINS CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Otis and Delphine both buy shares of the same growing stock.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel in a doctor's office of man otis and woman delphine each holding a rising stock chart labeled SAME STOCK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Holding over one year unlocks lower long-term capital gains rates.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a chart of a calendar arrow past ONE YEAR labeled LOWER RATE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Otis sells all his shares after just eleven impatient months.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man otis pressing a SELL button, a calendar stamped ELEVEN MONTHS, exam room background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That short-term gain gets taxed fully at his ordinary income rate.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man otis holding a profit slip stamped TAXED AS INCOME, doctor's office background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Delphine waits until she has held it past one year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, patient woman delphine beside a calendar stamped OVER ONE YEAR in an exam room, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her profit now qualifies for the much lower long-term rate.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman delphine holding a profit slip stamped LONG-TERM RATE, doctor's office desk, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The holding date was the only real difference between them.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a chart of two calendars with only the sell date differing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Otis hands a big chunk of his profit straight to taxes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, glum man otis handing a large slice of coins to a jar labeled TAXES, exam room background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Delphine keeps far more after paying that lower long-term rate.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, smiling woman delphine holding a big stack of coins labeled KEPT MORE in a doctor's office, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same stock and gain, but very different final tax bills.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man otis with a big tax bill and woman delphine with a small tax bill, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: When possible, hold winning investments past one year for lower taxes. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room holding a clipboard reading HOLD PAST ONE YEAR, comic burst banner reads STAY HEALTHY, kids comic book illustration
